Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human SRC kinase (CHEMBL267). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL267 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
